name: ov
summary: Feature-rich terminal pager that understands columns, headers, compressed files and follow mode
description: ov is a pager meant to replace less for structured text. It can fix header rows and columns while you scroll, align CSV and tabular output, highlight matches, follow growing files like tail -f, open gzip/bzip2/zstd/xz files directly, wrap or scroll horizontally, and act as a pager for psql or other tools. Keybindings and styles are configurable in YAML.
